presentation.label: MIDI FEEDBACK
presentation.summary: Automatic feedback for seven parameters per drum track, for controller pickup.
presentation.overview: Sends parameter changes and a full background refresh about every two seconds over DIN MIDI OUT. Enable once per project; no menu visit is required while performing. Emulator lifecycle and physical USB PC12 Track Level pickup tests passed; Rytm hardware qualification remains pending.
highlights: Automatic background refresh; no performance-time menu diving.
Seven assignments per track; choose your own PC12 pot layout.
Latest-value feedback with bounded, fair output.
usage: In MIDI CONFIG, set distinct track channels, PARAM OUTPUT to CC, ENCODER DEST to INT+EXT, and OUTPUT TO to MIDI or MIDI+USB.
Map PC12 pots to the listed CCs and track channels, enable snap mode, and route feedback into the PC12 without MIDI THRU back to Rytm.
Press GLOBAL, select MIDI FEEDBACK, and press YES for ON. Feedback then refreshes automatically; SEND FEEDBACK is optional.

steps: Scroll to MIDI FEEDBACK and press YES to set ON.
Leave it ON for automatic feedback; SEND FEEDBACK is optional.

controls.name: MIDI FEEDBACK
controls.doc: Toggle feedback, off by default; stored per project.

controls.name: SEND FEEDBACK
controls.doc: Optional immediate refresh of all 84 assignments; background refresh already runs every two seconds while ON.

limitations: Experimental: automatic refresh and emulator lifecycle checked; Rytm hardware qualification and release packaging pending.
Feedback is DIN-only on Rytm; the Windows/WSL bridge used USB only for the PC12.
Physical USB PC12 Track Level pickup passed with the emulator; Rytm hardware qualification is pending.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

tests.summary: Pinned source-only package reproduced twice and passed nine emulator lifecycle checks. Earlier PC12 Track Level pickup and menu checks passed; physical Rytm qualification and publication remain pending.
